title: feat(objectql, core, metadata)!: tool names held per namespace, and the metadata service keeps each package's tool in its own (package, name) slot (ADR-0150 child B)
body:

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgF87Pkrp3pwB6pK7H7tAULL)_
domain:server#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CXccws8fKuKv883Vom

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：工具（tool）的同名规则从「整个部署只能有一个包持有」放宽到「每个命名空间一个」，和 agent、skill、action、邮件模板一样；同时元数据服务把 tool 按（包，名字）分槽存，两个包的同名工具都保留。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 第 14 张 B 卡。包里的 tool 记录在开源仓只有 `/meta/tool/NAME` 一个按名读取处，它早已按包解析；main 现在要求「放宽的类型」必须同时进按包存储的集合，所以这次两处一起改。
- 风险与回滚：BREAKING，但只动进程内元数据服务的四个答案（无包名读两包同名的 tool 由「最后注册的」改为 409、点名两个包等），第一方调用方 0；HTTP 与 MCP 门不变。同命名空间共有者、无命名空间的包、base/system/sys、内置名照旧被拒，原句不变。回滚就是把 `tool` 从两个集合里删掉。
- 先看：`packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`（集合加 `tool`）、`packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts`（存储集合加 `tool`）、`registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts`、`packages/spec/liveness/tool.json`（给云端的前置条件）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts -t tool`，应全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地；云端读数回来之前保持 draft。

Fixes #31985
Supersedes #32081

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — widened: the engine's package door (`SchemaRegistry.installPackage`), its item seam (`SchemaRegistry.registerItem`) and the cold boot's holder seal (`SchemaRegistry.sealBareNameHolders`) accept, for a tool, a second package holder from another declared namespace. Narrowed: `tool` joins `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES`, so four in-process answers of the metadata service for a tool move from served to refused or empty (rows 4–7 below); first-party callers 0.
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` and `content/docs/**` teach no tool rename on a cross-namespace clash, no in-process `get('tool', …)` and no `/layers?package=` read of a tool (`git grep` at this head).

> **Draft condition (epic seat, ruling 6760270915).** This PR leaves draft only on a fresh, dated cloud reading that answers **no** to both questions of the epic seat's request 6760281500 (does the cloud resolve a package `tool` record by bare name, and does anything in the cloud read package `tool` records at all). That request went to cloud mailbox #31366, which closed unanswered, and was re-sent to mailbox #31704 at 6764379799. If either answer is yes, this PR is `Blocked-by` the cloud change that resolves them by package. **Evidence today:** the two dated cloud readings recorded in `packages/spec/liveness/tool.json` (cloud `@15f55df`, 2026-08-29, and cloud `@cb62c3ea`, 2026-10-02, by the repo:cloud seat on #20274: "an authored tool record never becomes a tool definition"). No fresher reading exists on this card or in this PR as of 2026-11-12.
>
> **Landing order.** After #31696 PR-3 (`claude/project-thread-wqgmuu`), #31700 (PR #32513, `claude/project-thread-du44hj`) and #31699 PRs 2/3, each of which edits `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` and `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES`. This branch merges `origin/main` after each of them lands (merge, never rebase). The seat lands it.

## What changes

This PR takes over PR #32081 (branch `claude/project-thread-1o6x78`, head `c3d90f1c86`), keeping its three commits, and merges `origin/main` `21667430` into them. Main moved under it:

- `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` now lives in `@objectstack/core` (`package-scoped-resolution.ts`); `bare-name-one-holder.ts` re-exports it. So `tool` joins it there, beside the AI family (`agent`, `skill`, `tool`, then `action`, `email_template`).
- `@objectstack/metadata`'s `package-slotted-store.ts` requires a type to join `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` in the same change that narrows it (objectql's ai-family test pins the subset per narrowed type). So `tool` joins it here, and the in-memory store, `MemoryLoader`, `DatabaseLoader` and `migrateDatabaseLoaderRowPackages` treat a tool by the rules they already apply to `agent` and `skill`. The seat ruled this widened file surface (Claim amendment 6813895874, option A).

Files:

- `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`: `tool` joins `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES`; doc names it.
- `packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts`: `tool` joins `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES`; doc names it.
- `packages/objectql/src/bare-name-one-holder.ts`: doc only. The module doc says why `tool` qualifies (its one by-name reader already resolves by package; it has no AI face to carry), and `BUILT_IN_BARE_NAMES`' doc records the census (0).
- `packages/spec/liveness/tool.json` (`_note` only; the one `packages/spec` edit the epic seat allowed, claim amendment 6760298444): the precondition on the first reader of a package `tool` record.
- `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__objectql__src__bare-name-one-holder.ts.json`: the invariant names `tool` beside agent and skill.
- `.changeset/31985-tool-names-per-namespace.md` (`@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/metadata` minor).
- Tests: see Tests.

## Why

ADR-0150 D9 narrows a type's one-holder refusal once its by-name readers, its AI face and its stored references carry the package. Step 0 (`/mnt/project-files/server-seat2/31985-step0.md`, read at `48f18b58`) measured all three for `tool`; the seat ruled the card ships as one narrowing PR (claim amendment 6760255704: Q1 = A, no `Part of` PR; Q2 = A, built-in census 0). Each reading below is re-measured on this head's tree (`origin/main` `21667430` merged).

### Readings (a)–(d)

- **(a) Face (D6).** No surface in this repo shows a package `tool` record to a model or an MCP client. The MCP stdio bridge (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts`, `bridgeTools`) lists the AI service's live `ToolRegistry`, whose `AIToolDefinition` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/ai-service.ts`) carries no package and is minted from platform code and actions, never from a `tool` record. HTTP MCP never bridges that registry. Skill prompts do not project `tools[]`. Agent tool binding is cloud-only (`ai/skill.zod.ts`: CLOUD-RUNTIME-ONLY). Re-measured: no source changed between `ff04ad81` and `21667430` adds a reader of a `tool` record (the ten changed sources that mention a tool were read; none reads one).
- **(b) Caller references (D3).** `agent.tools` was removed in spec 17; tools reach an agent only through its skills (ADR-0064). A skill's `tools[]` is resolved only by the cloud runtime, against its live registry; the spec calls a `stack.tools` record "inert". The static R7 lint (`packages/lint/src/validate-ai-tool-references.ts`) is per stack and never environment-wide. The one runtime by-name reader, `/meta/tool/NAME`, resolves by `(package, name)` (`tool` is in `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`, child E8), and the G1 qualified door `/meta/tool/NS/NAME` reaches each holder.
- **(c) Stored references.** D8 has no `tool` row; S4's report rows (`packages/cli/src/utils/stored-package-references.ts`) hold 0 `tool` rows. First-party tool records in `examples/`: 0 (the one `tools:` hit, `examples/app-showcase/scripts/mcp-fixture.mjs`, is an MCP fixture server's tool list, not a package record). The S4 integration fixture carries a two-namespace tool name and pins that the sealed-clash section does not list it. What this change adds to storage is the slot keying of rows 7–8.
- **(d) Built-in names.** Platform-requested tool names (`PLATFORM_REQUESTED_BARE_NAMES_BY_TYPE`, `@objectstack/core`): **0** (it holds `permission` and `email_template` only). The 41 platform-provided names (`PLATFORM_PROVIDED_TOOL_NAMES`) live in the AI service's registry, not this registry, and are not refused (seat ruling Q2 = A), so nothing new narrows.

### In-repo pins this relies on

- `/meta/tool/NAME` read by package: `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts` (child E8, `tool` in `E8_TYPES`).
- The `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` answer, naming both holders, on a bare `/meta/tool/NAME` read with two holders: `packages/qa/dogfood/test/bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.dogfood.test.ts` ("the bare by-name read refuses 409 naming both holders; `?package=` serves each package's own", which covers `tool`), and in-process the `[#31985]` pin through `SchemaRegistry.resolveItem`.

## Moved answers (FROM → TO)

FROM is `origin/main` `21667430`; TO is this head.

| # | Surface | FROM | TO | Arm | Pin |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `installPackage` / `registerItem` of a package whose namespace differs from the tool name's holder's | refused `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` naming both holders | installs | widening | ai-family "the narrowing" matrix (`tool`), dogfood third-namespace install-local |
| 2 | cold boot of two namespaces' holders of one tool name | boots with one bare-name warning naming the tool | boots, no warning | widening | ai-family cold-boot pin; dogfood "no bare-name warning" |
| 3 | `os migrate stored-references` sealed clashes | listed two namespaces' tool holders | not listed | widening | `stored-references.integration.test.ts` |
| 4 | `MetadataManager.get('tool', NAME)` / `getDiagnosed`, no package, two holders | item registered (or saved) last | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (`ambiguous-in-environment`) naming both | narrowing | metadata #32151 / #32246 SLOTTED pins (`tool`), dogfood artifact-door block |
| 5 | `get('tool', NAME, PKG)` / `getDiagnosed`, PKG holds no slot, another does (one holder or two) | the stored item | `undefined`; no loader asked | narrowing | metadata #32151 pin, dogfood "answers nothing" |
| 6 | `unregister('tool', NAME)` no package, two holders; rollback of a name with two slots' rows | resolves (deleted nothing / overwrote the first row) | `409` naming every holder, before any delete, event or write | narrowing | metadata #32198 / #32246 SLOTTED pins |
| 7 | `DatabaseLoader.delete` by name, no package, two holders | deleted the first row | refused | narrowing | metadata #32246 SLOTTED pins |
| 8 | `DatabaseLoader.save` of a tool | one row per name, `package_id` empty | one row per `(package, name)`, `package_id` filled; versions numbered per name | storage | metadata #32246 SLOTTED pins; `migrateDatabaseLoaderRowPackages` pins (`tool`) |
| 9 | `list('tool')`, `GET /meta/tool` with two holders | the survivor | each package's item | widening | metadata SLOTTED `list` pins |
| 10 | `GET /meta/tool/NAME/layers?package=PKG`, two holders, artifact boot | the other package's body | PKG's own | fix | dogfood artifact-door `/layers?package=` (`tool`) |
| 11 | bare `/meta/tool/NAME` on a registry whose `readsByPackage('tool')` is `false` | `getItem`'s first match | `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` | narrowing (no in-repo composition: `SchemaRegistry` answers `true`) | `package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts` (b) `it.each` over the narrowed set |

First-party reach of rows 4–7 and 11: **0**. No production source calls `get`, `getDiagnosed`, `unregister` or `rollback` with the type `tool`; first-party tool records in `examples/`: 0; on a booted stack `/meta/tool/**` and MCP read through the protocol, which already resolved a tool by `(package, name)`.

Still refused, each with today's envelope and sentence: a co-owner of the holder's namespace (for a tool that is the namespace co-owner rule's `NamespaceNameConflictError`, child N, which judges a tool ahead of this rule at every install, boot included, exactly as before this change), a package with no namespace beside any holder, two packages of one shareable namespace (`base`, `system`, `sys`), and a built-in name.

## Carried to repo:cloud

Once tool records stop being inert (cloud Phase 2), or any cloud change first reads a package `tool` record: that reader **must** resolve a name from the referring item's own package (its own record, else the unique holder in its declared dependency closure, ADR-0150 D3), **must** refuse a name two packages hold, naming every candidate, and must never take the first one registered, never reach a tool outside that closure, and never reach a tool only the environment holds. The same obligation is written into `packages/spec/liveness/tool.json` as a precondition of that change.

## Tests

Forced test edits (each pinned the old rule):

- `packages/objectql/src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts`: #31973's `tool` CONTROL ("a tool has not narrowed") flipped into the narrowing pin (two namespaces install; each package's caller is served its own; the bare read refuses 409 naming both). `tool` joins `NARROWED`, so the full narrowing matrix runs for it, and the switch pin reads `[...NARROWED, 'action', 'email_template']`. The matrix rival for a tool is a package with **no namespace** (an agent's and a skill's stays a co-owner), because the namespace co-owner rule refuses a tool's co-owner first; the two co-owner cases of the matrix register for agent and skill only, and two pins hold the tool co-owner on that rule's envelope at the package door and through the cold boot. The #32151 "both kept" pin now runs for `tool`.
- `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`: its "covered type not narrowed (tool) keeps `getItem`" CONTROL now uses `dashboard`, a package-scoped type no one-holder rule covers, so no later child B card moves it; the narrowed-type `it.each` now runs for `tool` (row 11).
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.dogfood.test.ts`: the cold boot of two namespaces' tool holders logs no bare-name warning; the qualified-read pin covers `tool`; the install-local tool case is a third-namespace tool that installs and a co-owner tool refused on the namespace co-owner rule's sentence. The artifact-door block (#32151) ships a tool per package and a solo tool, and every one of its six pins runs for `tool` (rows 4, 5, 10).
- `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts`: the #32151 in-memory pins' list is `agent`, `skill`, `tool`. The #32198 removal and #32246 loader-storage pins iterate `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES`, so they run for `tool` with no edit, as do the `migrateDatabaseLoaderRowPackages` pins.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/stored-references.integration.test.ts`: the fixture's two namespaces also share a tool name, and the sealed-clash section still lists only the picklist.

Ablations (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty; logs in the os-dev report):

- **Predicate.** `tool` removed from `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` (`packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`, anchor 1 → 0, blob `967d7523` → `9d7d245f`), core rebuilt: `vitest run src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts -t tool` went red, **7 failed** (the switch pin, the two-namespace install pin, the item-seam pin, the cold-boot pin, the `[#31985]` resolve pin and both co-owner pins, whose setup installs two namespaces).
- **Store.** `tool` removed from `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` (`packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts`, anchor 1 → 0, blob `413160b0` → `b4472dcb`), metadata rebuilt: objectql's "both kept" pin for `tool` went red (1 failed), and metadata's #32151 pins `-t tool` went red (**5 failed**).

## Acceptance notes

- `NAMESPACE_UNIQUE_TYPES` (child N) still lists `tool`, so a tool's same-namespace co-owner is refused by N's sentence, not this rule's. That is today's answer, unchanged; noted so a reader of the matrix knows why the tool's rival differs.
- The 41 platform-provided tool names are not built-ins here; if a later change makes package tool records reach the AI service's registry, that change owns the name clash with them.
- `tool` sits beside the AI family in `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` (after `skill`, before `action`), not at the end, so the sibling B branches that append their type after `email_template` (#31696 PR-3 `flow`, #31700's data and request types) merge with it textually.
